fr_html: Le PRESIDENT insiste pour qu'on discute simultanément les trois textes, méthode qui lui semble la plus simple et la plus claire.
en_html: The PRESIDENT insisted that they discuss the three projects simultaneously, the method which seemed to him clearest and simplest.
